sloka: द्वारेषु सम्स्कृता भीमाः काल आयस मयाः शिताः ।शतशो रोचिता वीरैः शतघ्न्यो रक्षसाम् गणैः ॥६-३-१३॥।।
transliteration: dvāreṣu samskṛtā bhīmāḥ kāla āyasa mayāḥ śitāḥ ।śataśo rocitā vīraiḥ śataghnyo rakṣasām gaṇaiḥ ॥6-3-13॥।।

translations.english: At the entrances are troops of terrific looking guards kept ready with a hundred sharpened stones studded with iron spikes.
